items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb05rIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dc768ee283c6c1e62c0837379e603c94a74134e7/8O6uwz0.jpg) Welcome to Katipunan One Big F2L! This competition features the events **3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One-Handed, Skewb, 4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5 Blindfolded**, with **3x3 Cube** as the main event. NOTE: With the venue's limited size, we highly encourage competitors to limit the number of guests accompanying them to ensure that the venue is not overcrowded. **Competitors are also required to indicate the names of their accompanying guests for campus venue access, please refer to the [Venue Access tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KatipunanOneBigF2L2024#38191-venue-access-form) for more details.** We also encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing. This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, and is **not** affiliated with Ateneo de Manila University in any form. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbGxrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5102bbd4f46cf6b6c9e94dc8e0a1283b8c05677/BCD44wd.png)
